info.title: repoctx
info.description: Local-first, explainable project memory for AI coding agents.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: RepoContext - local-first, explainable project memory for AI coding agents.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: init
commands.description: Initialize a RepoContext index in the current repository.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing configuration. [default: False]

options.name: --agents
options.description: Add RepoContext usage instructions to CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md. [default: False]

options.name: --no-agents
options.description: Skip the CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md prompt and leave those files untouched. [default: False]

commands.name: index
commands.description: Build or incrementally update the index.

options.name: --full
options.description: Force a full rebuild instead of an incremental update. [default: False]

commands.name: search
commands.description: Full-text search across the indexed repository.

options.name: --top
options.description: Maximum number of results. [default: 10]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text, json or md. [default: text]

options.name: --symbols
options.description: Restrict the search to symbols (classes, functions, ...). [default: False]

commands.name: related
commands.description: Show files related to a given file (imports, tests, dependents).

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text, json or md. [default: text]

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: The file to find related files for.

commands.name: context
commands.description: Return a compact, explained context bundle for a natural-language task.

options.name: --top
options.description: Maximum number of files. [default: 8]

options.name: --budget-tokens
options.description: Token budget the bundle is packed into (real BPE counts).

options.name: --detail
options.description: Per-file detail: paths (pointers), outline (symbol skeletons) or slices (source content). [default: paths]

options.name: --snippets
options.description: Alias for --detail slices. [default: False]

options.name: --known
options.description: A file you already have, as <path>@<hash> (repeatable). Unchanged files come back as zero-cost markers.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text, json or md. [default: text]

arguments.name: TASK
arguments.description: A natural-language description of what you want to do.

commands.name: outline
commands.description: Show a file's skeleton (symbols, signatures, docs) instead of its content.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text, json or md. [default: text]

commands.name: changed
commands.description: Show working-tree changes since the last index and the files they impact.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text, json or md. [default: text]

commands.name: architecture
commands.description: Summarize the repository structure, languages and central files.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text, json or md. [default: text]

options.name: --depth
options.description: Directory-tree depth (1 gives a minimal orientation summary). [default: 3]

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Run the MCP server over stdio (tools: repoctx.search, repoctx.get_context, repoctx.get_related_files). The server reads/writes JSON-RPC on stdin/stdout.
